code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    panels = None
    for r in range(h):
        if r == h - r - 1 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]):
            panels = (grid[:r], grid[r + 1:])
            break
    if panels is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if c == w - c - 1 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
                panels = ([row[:c] for row in grid], [row[c + 1:] for row in grid])
                break
    if panels is None:
        raise ValueError("No centered solid divider found")
    a, b = panels
    shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    background = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if x == y else background for x, y in zip(ar, br)] for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
'''
